nevertypeof.description: A NeverTypeOfError occurs when a parameter is of a type that is explicitly disallowed.

examples.misuse: The password entered into the init method should never be of the type String.
examples.solution: Instead, it should be of the type char[].

examples.misuse: The passwords used in the methods load, store, and getKey should never be of the type String.
examples.solution: Instead, it should be of the type char[].

examples.misuse: The password used in the constructor should never be of the type String.
examples.solution: Instead, it should be of the type char[].

examples.misuse: The password used in the constructor should never be of the type String.
